description.text: AI-written synthesis of the StartX homepage, prepared by the collecting assistant: the page calls StartX the premier community for Stanford founders and says it takes no equity and charges no fees. A banner says "Apply to StartX Fellows by Nov 1" and does not give a year or a time, so that date is not stored. The page prints its own totals: $200B total valuation, $44M raised on average, 144 companies valued at over $100M, and 29 companies valued at over $1B. A separate "$200K" line on the page is a donation campaign, not an investment in admitted companies, and it is not stored as a term.

targetApplicants.text: AI-written interpretation of the homepage, prepared by the collecting assistant: the page says StartX is for Stanford's founders and describes itself as a founder-led community. The Fellows banner is a separate apply path. The page does not, in the text that was kept, define which Stanford affiliation is required.

sources.title: StartX homepage — No equity, no fees, Fellows date without a year
sources.quote:
Apply to StartX Fellows by Nov 1

The Premier Community for Stanford Founders
StartX is a trusted, founder-led community built on deep collaboration, shared experience, and long-term support. We take no equity and charge no fees.

StartX is dedicated to empowering Stanford’s most accomplished and visionary entrepreneurs.
$200B Total Valuation
$44M Raised on Average
144 Companies valued at over $100M
29 Companies valued at over $1B

limitations: The application questions were not opened. No account was created, no terms were accepted, and nothing was submitted. Fields stay empty and Start Application stays blocked.

"Apply to StartX Fellows by Nov 1" has no year, clock, or timezone. deadlineAt and dateOnly stay empty. The page's $200K fundraising banner is a donation campaign and is not an accelerator investment.
